selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed curl package at its current version during updates
selected_evidence.summary: DNF lists the exact lock; before and after restart, real update attempts report nothing to do and curl remains 0:8.9.1-5.el10.x86_64. Disabling the plugin only for a read-only check exposes version 8.12.1, proving the hold is effective.

selected_evidence.requirement: Use software compatible with the legacy platform
selected_evidence.summary: The signed RHEL repository supplied python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock 4.7.0-10.el10 and matching EL10 DNF plugin components.
RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 are identical before and after all work and the restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: The healthy pre-restart boot ID was 7217fc31-8b1e-4097-936b-13f98cd8a5df; systemd acknowledged the safe reboot; the recovered boot ID is cb56e55e-9ec0-4616-964e-a66132eb2dca. Post-restart checks show the lock and checksum persisted, curl remained held, SSH recovered, SELinux is enforcing, the RPM database is valid, and no services failed.

commands.command:
set -u
printf '%s\n' '[post-restart-boot-and-platform]'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uname -r
. /etc/os-release
printf 'os=%s version=%s\n' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID"
printf '%s\n' '[post-restart-preserved-packages]'
rpm -q curl libcurl redhat-release kernel-core python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock --qf '%{NAME} %{EPOCHNUM}:%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}\n'
printf '%s\n' '[post-restart-lock-data]'
dnf versionlock list
stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/dnf/plugins/versionlock.list
sha256sum /etc/dnf/plugins/versionlock.list
printf '%s\n' '[post-restart-real-update-test]'
dnf -y upgrade curl
update_rc=$?
printf 'update-exit=%s\n' "$update_rc"
rpm -q curl --qf 'curl-after-update=%{EPOCHNUM}:%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}\n'
printf '%s\n' '[post-restart-negative-control]'
dnf -q --disableplugin=versionlock check-update curl
control_rc=$?
printf 'unlocked-check-exit=%s\n' "$control_rc"
printf '%s\n' '[post-restart-curl-runtime]'
curl --version | sed -n '1,2p'
printf '%s\n' '[post-restart-integrity-security-access]'
rpm -V curl
printf 'curl-rpm-verify-exit=%s\n' "$?"
rpm --verifydb
printf 'rpmdb-verify-exit=%s\n' "$?"
getenforce
systemctl is-system-running
systemctl is-active sshd
systemctl is-enabled sshd
systemctl --failed --no-pager
ss -lntup 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '[transient-reboot-unit-residue]'
systemctl list-units --all '[REDACTED]*' --no-legend --no-pager || true
